title: 第2083章 双双突破阳神境第2082章 水诗诗的变化
content_zh:
只是现在萧天的笑容怎看都有点贱贱的感觉。
当然了，李娅也是明白接下来要做什么。
虽然从醒来到现在的这两三天时间里她也是想了无数遍。
毕竟她已经把阴阳龙凤欢喜神诀修炼到小成阶段，对于这个功能和作用自然是十分的了解。
再加上之前听到的种种，串联起来，自己要经历什么也就推测出了七七八八。
此刻的她心中既是期待，又有点忐忑。
李娅担心自己做得不够好，同时因为这是她第一次双修，心情自然是紧张的。
“以前那些姐妹说，双修是一个非常欢乐的过程就是时间非常短，一般不会超过数个时辰。要是能达到半天的那都是天赋异禀了！也不知道是不是真的。”此刻李娅心中也是暗暗的想着。
萧天看着李娅那精致绝美的脸庞，也是忍不住的一阵的激动。
刚刚平静的心态也是再次变得激动起来。
“我的好姐姐，你在想什么呢？”萧天笑着说道。
“哦.....我...我没有想什么！你....接下来要怎么修炼？”慌乱之中，李娅也是自己主动说了出来。
当然自己说出这话之后，李娅也是知道自己太孟浪了，于是赶忙说道“我....就是....就是功法上说道的.....”
李娅想要解释，而萧天则是率先说道“嘻嘻....看来我的好姐姐已经做好了充分的准备了！”
萧天说完之后也是上前抱住了李娅。
李娅也是被萧天的动作给吓了一跳，身体也是一震！接着身体也是一软，就这么倒在了萧天的怀中。
感受到李娅那柔软而富有弹性的身体，萧天的内心也是变得更加的激动。
随后萧天也是低下头，轻轻的吻住李娅那娇艳的红唇....
下一刻，萧天也是感受到了一阵阵的空间波动！
当她再次的睁眼的时候，已经到了神元液的池子之中，感受到那清凉的神元液，李娅也是微微的吸了一口气。

神元特有的气息混合着萧天身上的清香，让她陶醉！
就在这时，李娅也是看到了萧天身上强大的地方。
如此宏伟，也是让李娅感到无比的震惊！
“这是真的吗？我可从来没有听说过，人族可以有如此规模的存在，难道以前那些姐妹说的都是假的！可是不可能呀！那些姐妹可不会骗我！可是，这....这也太夸张了吧！”看着萧天天赋异禀的模样，李娅也是震惊了！
甚至李娅都在想自己接下来要承受的是一件如此紧迫的事情！
在李娅所了解的知识里，神龙族应该是这方面的佼佼者。
但神龙族高傲，很少在人族面前露面！所以知道的人也是少之又少。
而对于神龙一族，对于那方面的能力那是公认的强大！即便是龙族强者一次要好几天。这样的能力可不是一般人族可以比拟的。
但化成人族形态的龙族也没有这么强大的！
看着李娅也是内心一阵颤抖。
“这.....也....太.....”李娅心中默默的想着。
而就在这时，萧天已经行动了。
随着一声嘹亮的歌声在神元液池子之中响起，修炼也是正式拉开了序幕。
而这个世界时候李娅也是真真切切的感受到什么叫天赋异禀。
人族之内她从来没有听过有如此强大之人，虽然这种能力很少被关注。
但是当强大到一定程度之后那必然是十分的出名的！
反正李娅也是从来没有听过。
而此刻的李娅也是眉头微微皱起，疼哭的表情也是浮现在脸上。
“那些姐妹也真是的，什么快乐无比，我怎么还没感觉到快乐？有的是那压迫.....”此刻的李娅也是对自己的好姐妹给埋怨起来。
殊不知这还因为她第一次修炼，而且还是刚刚开始，自然是需要一个过程去适应。

等适应了这个强度自然不会有不舒服的感觉！
不等李娅多思考，如同潮水般的能量也是瞬间将她给淹没。
接着她就完全沉浸在这特殊的修炼之中。
随着修炼的深入，李娅的修为也是在发生着快速的变化。
在第五天的时候，李娅的修为也是正式的跨入到阳神境七层！
content_en:
It's just that Xiao Tian's smile now feels a bit mean.
Of course, Li Ya also knew what to do next.
Although she has thought about it countless times in the two or three days since she woke up.
After all, she has already practiced the Yin-Yang Dragon-Phoenix Divine Jue of Joy to the stage of completion, so she naturally understands this function and effect very well.
Coupled with everything I heard before, and connected in series, I can guess what I will go through.
At this moment, she was both looking forward to it and a little nervous.
Li Ya was worried that she was not doing well enough. At the same time, because this was her first dual cultivation, she was naturally nervous.
"Those sisters used to say that dual cultivation is a very joyful process, but the time is very short, usually no more than a few hours. If you can do it for half a day, you are extremely talented! I don't know if it is true." At this moment, Li Ya was also thinking secretly in her heart.
Xiao Tian couldn't help but feel excited when he looked at Li Ya's exquisite and beautiful face.
The calm state of mind just now became excited again.
"My good sister, what are you thinking about?" Xiao Tian said with a smile.
"Oh...I...I didn't think about anything! You...how are you going to practice next?" In panic, Li Ya also took the initiative to speak out.
Of course, after she said this, Li Ya also knew that she was too Menglang, so she quickly said, "I...just...it's what the technique says..."
Li Ya wanted to explain, but Xiao Tian was the first to say, "Hehe... It seems that my good sister is fully prepared!"
After Xiao Tian finished speaking, he also stepped forward and hugged Li Ya.
Li Ya was also startled by Xiao Tian's actions, and her body was also shaken! Then his body went limp, and he fell into Xiao Tian's arms.
Feeling Li Ya's soft and elastic body, Xiao Tian became even more excited.
Then Xiao Tian also lowered his head and gently kissed Li Ya's beautiful red lips...
The next moment, Xiao Tian also felt waves of space fluctuations!
When she opened her eyes again, she was already in the pool of divine essence liquid. Feeling the cool divine essence liquid, Li Ya also took a slight breath.
The unique breath of Shen Yuan mixed with the fragrance of Xiao Tian made her intoxicated!
At this moment, Li Ya also saw the powerful part of Xiao Tian.
Such magnificence also shocked Li Ya!
"Is this true? I have never heard that the human race can exist on such a scale. Could it be that what those sisters said before were all lies! But it's impossible! Those sisters would not lie to me! But, this... this is too exaggerated!" Looking at Xiao Tian's talented appearance, Li Ya was also shocked!
Even Li Ya was thinking that what she had to bear next was such an urgent matter!
According to Li Ya's knowledge, the Shenlong Clan should be the leader in this field.
But the Divine Dragon Clan is arrogant and rarely shows up in front of the human race! So very few people know about it.
As for the Shenlong clan, their ability in that area is recognized as powerful! Even the strong dragon clan can do it for several days at a time. This kind of ability is not comparable to that of ordinary humans.
But the dragons in human form are not so powerful!
Looking at Li Ya, her heart trembled.
"This...is...too..." Li Ya thought silently in her heart.
But at this moment, Xiao Tian had already taken action.
As a loud song sounded in the pool of Divine Essence Liquid, the practice officially began.
In this world, Li Ya also truly felt what it meant to be gifted.
She had never heard of such a powerful person in the human race, although this ability was rarely noticed.
But when it becomes powerful to a certain extent, it will definitely become very famous!
oppositeZheng Li Ya has never heard of it.
At this moment, Li Ya also frowned slightly, and a crying expression appeared on her face.
"Those sisters are really so happy. Why don't I feel happy yet? It's so oppressive..." At this moment, Li Ya also complained about her good sisters.
Little did she know that this was because it was her first time practicing, and she had just started, so it naturally took a process to get used to.
Once you get used to the intensity, you won't feel any discomfort!
Before Li Ya could think about it, the tide of energy instantly overwhelmed her.
Then she became completely immersed in this special practice.
With the deepening of practice, Li Ya's cultivation level is also undergoing rapid changes.
On the fifth day, Li Ya's cultivation also officially entered the seventh level of Yangshen Realm!
